Demam di kawasan wabak denggi? Jangan tunggu sampai parah. 

Jika anda tinggal di kawasan wabak denggi dan mengalami demam, segera ambil tindakan:

✅ Maklumkan kepada petugas kesihatan bahawa anda berada di kawasan wabak denggi
✅ Pantau gejala seperti muntah, sakit perut atau lemah badan
✅ Dapatkan rawatan segera di fasiliti kesihatan berhampiran

Ambil peduli, cegah denggi. Bertindak awal boleh menyelamatkan nyawa.

Candlestick Reading in Forex Trading 🕯

Understanding Green Candlesticks 

🔼 Green candlesticks show price increases:

- Top Wick: Highest price.
- Top of Body: Closing price.
- Bottom of Body: Opening price.
- Bottom Wick: Lowest price.

Understanding Red Candlesticks

🔽 Red candlesticks show price decreases:

- Top Wick: Highest price.
- Top of Body: Opening price.
- Bottom of Body: Closing price.
- Bottom Wick: Lowest price.

Green means price went up, red means price went down.

Understanding these basics helps you make better trading decisions. 👌
